title: What the Dossier Rests On
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (study 64, before the programme is chosen): two interactive figures in plain script, no library; numbers from extract64.py, probe64.py and analyse64.py
embodies: Every figure of the Middle's programme dossier checked against the page it links (61 of 61 stand), and every dataset its Reach scores name probed once without an account (9 of 21 deliver; four candidates have none that does; Reach does not follow what delivers, rho -0.05).
